mechanism_and_quality_notes: The ochre/magenta letterpress ring makes Harness dominant. Unequal detachable Coding, Sandbox, MCP, Tracing and Memory lobes remain separate, while a single Agent Skills arrow enters an attachment port. Tools and Instructions are printed on the skill booklet itself, and Workspace now names the formerly unexplained lower interface. Model is a separate leaf; the detached beta/single-run caveat prevents benchmark superiority claims. Twelve exact phrases occur once, with no fake writing or controls. The visibly radial printed topology differs from the locked paired engraving and continuous paper fabric.
